idea-plugin.name: Git Workflow Enforcer
idea-plugin.description:
Git Workflow Enforcer — Automatic Branch, Commit, and Merge Validation

Stop catching Git convention violations in code reviews. Git Workflow Enforcer validates branch names, commit messages, and merge policies before commits happen — keeping your Git history clean and your team consistent.

Branch Naming

  • Enforce Gitflow, trunk-based, GitHub Flow, or custom naming patterns
  • Real-time validation with clear error messages
  • Configurable regex patterns for any naming convention

Commit Message Validation

  • Conventional Commits format enforcement
  • Configurable maximum subject length (default 72 characters)
  • JIRA/issue key requirement in commit messages
  • 11 allowed commit types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert

Merge and Push Policies

  • Block direct pushes to protected branches (main, master, develop)
  • Enforce pull request workflows
  • Merge direction validation (feature → develop, hotfix → main)
  • Required reviewers per file path (CODEOWNERS-like rules)

IDE Integration

  • Status bar widget with real-time compliance status
  • Pre-commit validation with block/warn options
  • Violations tool window grouped by type
  • Balloon notifications with fix suggestions

Team Configuration

  • Shared .git-workflow.yaml versioned in Git
  • Auto-reload when config file changes
  • Workflow presets: Gitflow, Trunk-Based, GitHub Flow, Custom

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3+ (or any JetBrains IDE build 243–252.*)
  • Git4Idea plugin (bundled with all JetBrains IDEs)
  • Java 17+

Support

  • GitHub: github.com/JirakJ/git-workflow-enforcer
  • Issues: Report a Bug
  • Author: Jakub Jirák
idea-plugin.change-notes:
What's New

  • Branch Name Validation - Enforce Gitflow, trunk-based, GitHub Flow, or custom naming conventions with regex patterns
  • Commit Message Checks - Validate Conventional Commits format, subject length, and JIRA issue references
  • Pre-Commit Validation - Block or warn on non-compliant commits before they happen
  • Status Bar Widget - Real-time compliance indicator showing green (compliant) or red (violations)
  • Violations Tool Window - View all violations grouped by type: branch naming, commit format, merge policy
  • Merge Policy Enforcement - Protect branches from direct pushes and enforce pull request workflows
  • Team Config File - Share rules across the team via a versioned .git-workflow.yaml file
  • Workflow Presets - Choose from Gitflow, Trunk-Based, GitHub Flow, or fully custom workflows
